dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer contains all delineated wetland areas within the City of Cambridge, including both open water and marsh areas.
Purpose: Created for the Cambridge Conservation Commission. The Wetlands layer is used for permitting, conservation restrictions, and general mapping purposes.
